title: Agents All the Way Down; A Methodology for Building Custom AI Agents from Substrate to Production
title_zh: Agents All the Way Down：从底层基质到生产环境构建定制 AI Agent 的方法论
abstract_en: Custom AI agents areagents that live inside their own application, talk to their own data and tools, enforce their own security boundaries, and carry their own brand and audit trail. What separates them from the general-purpose tier is fit, not capability: each is built for one job, by the engineer who will maintain it. No published practice sets out how to build one end to end. The pieces are everywhere (function-calling APIs, the Model Context Protocol, code agents to pair with), but the practice that chains them lives in podcasts, blogs, and leaked system prompts. This paper writes that practice down as a methodology, Agents All the Way Down: two preconditions crossed once and kept, then three practices repeated for the agent's life. The preconditions are (P1) Substrate, the LLM as a software component, framed as tools, then system, then messages under prompt-caching; and (P2) Building blocks: function calling, MCP, CLI orchestration, the liteshell pattern, the agent loop, skills, characters, hooks, and scaffolding. The practices are (P3) prototype with a general-purpose agent; (P4) harvest, fold, and ship the result as a CLI, the Turtle pattern; and (P5) agent-tests-agent, in which a general-purpose agent drives it through behavioural scenarios, a complement to classical testing, not a replacement. The working loop is P3 to P4 to P5 and back, and one corollary falls out for free: multi-agent orchestration is just CLI composition. The methodology is framework-free by construction. It was distilled from the AAC, a custom agent for the open-source LAMB platform, built in about ten days by one developer with an AI pair-programmer and in production . We present it as a transferable practice, independent of any language or framework.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一套端到端构建定制 AI Agent 的方法论：Agents All the Way Down。定制 AI Agent 指嵌入自身应用、连接自身数据与工具、执行自身安全边界，并具备品牌标识与审计轨迹的 Agent。它们与通用型 Agent 的区别不在能力，而在适配性：由维护它的工程师为特定任务构建。论文将零散存在于 function-calling APIs、Model Context Protocol（MCP）、代码 Agent、博客和系统提示词中的实践整理为可复用流程：先确立两个前置条件——P1 Substrate，即将 LLM 作为软件组件，并以 tools、system、messages 和 prompt-caching 组织；P2 Building blocks，包括 function calling、MCP、CLI orchestration、liteshell pattern、agent loop、skills、characters、hooks 与 scaffolding。随后在 Agent 生命周期中反复执行三项实践：P3 用通用 Agent 快速原型化；P4 收割、折叠并以 CLI 形式发布，即 Turtle pattern；P5 采用 agent-tests-agent，让通用 Agent 通过行为场景测试目标 Agent，作为传统测试的补充。论文强调该方法论不绑定具体框架，并基于作者为开源 LAMB 平台构建的 AAC 定制 Agent 提炼而来。
key_points_zh: 论文聚焦定制 AI Agent：运行在特定应用中，连接专属数据和工具，并内置安全边界、品牌与审计能力。
方法论包含两个前置条件：将 LLM 视为软件组件的 Substrate，以及由 function calling、MCP、CLI orchestration、agent loop 等组成的 Building blocks。
核心迭代流程为 P3→P4→P5：用通用 Agent 原型化，整理并封装为 CLI，通过 agent-tests-agent 做行为场景测试，再持续回环改进。
作者提出 Turtle pattern：把通用 Agent 产出的可用能力“收割、折叠、发布”为可维护的 CLI Agent。
论文主张多 Agent 编排本质上可视为 CLI composition，并强调该方法独立于具体语言或框架。

llm_assessment.comment: A practical end-to-end methodology for custom production agents with useful harness patterns, though much is codification rather than deep technical innovation.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一套面向生产级定制智能体的实用端到端方法论，包含有价值的框架模式，但更多是实践归纳而非深层技术突破。
